assessment: Authors present an interesting approach of COVID-19 multiorgan failure and loss of homeostasis attributed to modified adaptive immune response due to presence/absence of MDA5 polymorphism(rs1990760). Data presented by authors are very interesting representing novel scientific work that adds new and potentially pivotal information to existing knowledge. Key data presented strongly support an individualized approach during COVID-19 pandemic that could eventually alter therapeutic algorithm regarding dexamethasone administration implemented for these patients.
